# Coding with Kids

> > Coding with Kids offers progressive coding education through Coder's Ladder and Coder's Pathways curricula, serving 66,000+ students via group classes, private lessons, camps, and school partnerships across the US and internationally.

Founded in 2014, Coding with Kids is a leading provider of coding education for ages 5-18, operating in 10+ regions including Phoenix, Denver/Boulder, Washington D.C., Maryland, Portland, Pittsburgh, Austin, and online. The company partners with 900+ schools and offers multiple learning formats including live online camps, in-person enrichment classes, and specialized tracks in Python, Minecraft, Roblox, robotics, and AI.

## Core Programs & Curricula

- [Coder's Ladder® | Progressive Coding Curriculum for Kids](https://www.codingwithkids.com/coders-ladder): Flagship Coder's Ladder curriculum with progressive pathways for ages 5-18
- [Coder's Pathways® | Specialized Coding Tracks for Kids](https://www.codingwithkids.com/coders-pathways): Specialized Coder's Pathways tracks in Python, Minecraft, Roblox, robotics, AI
- [Online Group Coding Classes for Kids | Coder's Ladder®](https://www.codingwithkids.com/coders-ladder-group-classes): Coder's Ladder group classes with structured progression for ages 5-18
- [Private Coding Classes for Kids and Teens | Coding with Kids](https://www.codingwithkids.com/private-classes): One-on-one personalized coding lessons tailored to individual pace and interests

## Camps & Enrichment

- [Online Coding Camps for Kids and Teens | Coding with Kids](https://www.codingwithkids.com/online-camps): Live online coding camps with hands-on projects in Roblox, Minecraft, Python
- [In-Person Coding Camps for Kids and Teens | Coding with Kids](https://www.codingwithkids.com/in-person-camps): In-person summer camps with half-day and full-day options across regions
- [In-Person Enrichment Coding Classes | Coding with Kids](https://www.codingwithkids.com/in-person-enrichment-classes): School-year in-person enrichment classes in Roblox, Minecraft, Scratch, Python

## Schools & Organizations

- [Coding Programs for Schools | After-School and Elective Partnerships](https://www.codingwithkids.com/coding-programs-for-schools): School partnerships for after-school and elective programs trusted by 900+ schools

## Regional Programs

- [Online Coding Classes and Camps for Kids | Coding with Kids](https://www.codingwithkids.com/region/online-programs): Live online programs bringing coding education to students across US regions
- [Coding Classes and Camps in Phoenix Region | Coding with Kids](https://www.codingwithkids.com/region/phoenix): Phoenix region programs in Scottsdale, Chandler, Gilbert, Mesa since 2017
- [Coding Classes and Camps in Denver/Boulder Region | Coding with Kids](https://www.codingwithkids.com/region/denver-boulder): Denver/Boulder region programs serving nearly 100 Colorado schools since 2016
- [Coding Classes and Camps in D.C. Region | Coding with Kids](https://www.codingwithkids.com/region/washington-dc): Washington D.C. region programs across all areas (NE, NW, SE, SW) since 2019
- [Coding Classes and Camps in Maryland Region | Coding with Kids](https://www.codingwithkids.com/region/maryland): Maryland region programs in Silver Spring, Bethesda, Gaithersburg areas
- [Coding Classes and Camps in Portland Region | Coding with Kids](https://www.codingwithkids.com/region/portland): Portland region programs for K-8 since 2016 across Hillsboro and Lake Oswego
- [Coding Classes and Camps in Austin Region | Coding with Kids](https://www.codingwithkids.com/region/austin): Austin region programs serving 75+ schools across Greater Austin since 2016
- [Coding Classes and Camps in Pittsburgh Region | Coding with Kids](https://www.codingwithkids.com/region/pittsburgh): Pittsburgh region after-school and online programs established in 2024
